evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: We implement a methodology for evaluating LLMs on sequential triage, the task of predicting a triage acuity label from a growing prefix of a nurse-patient conversation.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We evaluate six LLMs at five sequential checkpoints on two corpora: 425 LLM-generated (SIMULATED) and 50 physician-authored (CLINICIAN) conversations, both labelled under the Emergency Severity Index (ESI).
